requirements.text: After reset, remain in INITIALIZING until initialization, validity, source usability, and essential-power conditions permit NORMAL operation.
Do not permit mission progression when neither source is usable.
When reserve energy is low, enter ENERGY_CONSERVATION and remove payload permission.
When return energy is insufficient, request return to home or a more conservative action.
When the main bus is critical, request immediate landing and nonessential-load shedding in the same logical cycle.
For a Battery A failure with Battery B usable, isolate only Battery A.
For a Battery B failure with Battery A usable, isolate only Battery B.
For dual-source unavailability, enter CRITICAL when essential power remains and LOCKOUT otherwise.
On payload overcurrent, remove payload permission and shed nonessential loads.
A persisted contactor mismatch shall latch a blocking fault and inhibit automatic return to NORMAL.
DEGRADED, CRITICAL, and LOCKOUT shall not transition directly to NORMAL without recovery staging or authorization.
Return to NORMAL shall require stable recovery and authorized reset where declared.
Invalid or stale required inputs shall invoke the conservative input-invalid policy.
A blocking runtime fault shall inhibit normal commit and invoke the fault-output policy.
State transitions and blocking faults shall produce bounded diagnostic identities.
Every output shall receive an unconditional deterministic default before conditional output logic.
Every supported executable statement shall be represented in AIR and executable by the reference interpreter and generated backend.
Identical controlled source, tool version, and configuration shall produce byte-identical authoritative artifacts.
